verdict.rationale: Cloud infrastructure platforms can plausibly ship background automation such as schedulers, event rules or serverless triggers, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents no first-party scheduled or autonomous background automation feature. The CLI, SDKs, REST API and Terraform are developer building blocks, and budget alerts are an adjacent control. The Select AI agent-team sharing note does not show autonomous background execution, and community cronjob and Jenkins setups are user-side workarounds.
